_comment: Measured 2026-11-20 by `node _tools/ko-census.mjs --json` on build 0.8.107. The gate refuses growth of one class: a DECISION that returns with no row of its own. Every defect this project spent a wave on had that shape (adUiHoldTick bailing out silently while a 62.6 s ad played; three freeze defects behind a green suite). Not every silent exit is a defect - `nativeStallIdle()` is silent by design (nothing happened, so nothing to report) - which is why the tool reports and the budget rules. Counts are a CEILING: lower them as a silent guard gets its row or its arm; never raise one without a ruling in AGENTS.md naming which new silence is acceptable. Tightened to the measured count on 2026-11-27 after (a) every conditional exit that decides about the picture, the audio or the pod was routed through `refuseValue()`, and (b) the classifier learned two things it was wrong about: a logging HELPER explains an exit even one indirection away, the window is the enclosing STATEMENT rather than three lines (a refusal row is a multi-line object here), and a value-production exit (`return {…}`, `return class …`) is not a decision. Both banks are proven with plants: a silent guard in `adUiHoldTick` and a guard one blank line below a row are still named. content.js 44->3, twitch-adblock.js 61->1 (the three `nativeStallIdle()` refusals are idle by design and the one left is a scheduled reveal that writes its row later). u
